recipe.title: Chicken saagwala
recipe.notes: This recipe is from 'Nadia's Kitchen' by Nadia Lim.

i.n: chicken thighs, boneless, cut into large chunks
fresh spinach, chopped, or 1.5 C frozen spinach

method.s: Heat oil in a large frying pan, add cumin and onions, and cook until starting to brown (about 5 minutes).
Remove onions and purée in a blender or food processor.
Add garlic, ginger and chicken pieces to pan and brown chicken on all sides.
Add chili powder, cloves and turmeric, and fry for a further few minutes.
If using fresh spinach, wilt in boiling water or by steaming in microwave with a bit of water.
Squeeze out excess water and purée spinach with the tomato and onion mixture.
Add spinach, tomato and onion purée to chicken and cook on medium heat until chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
